advisory.finding: The plan-review-T10 eval spec declares only the `emits_valid_findings` deterministic scorer (a schema-shape check), so the balanced pass/finding corpus is never scored for recall or false-fire — a finding case that emits no T10 finding, or a pass case that false-fires, still passes the gate. The sibling plan-review-finder.eval.yaml declares `no_fire_on_good_cases` and `recall_on_seeded_defects` for exactly this.
scenarios: A live eval run where the model misses a T10 MAJOR-class finding (e.g. the transient-plaintext-secret case) still passes because only schema shape is gated.
A false-fire on the loopback-throwaway pass case goes undetected.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add the two additional deterministic scorers to the `scorers:` list, mirroring plan-review-finder.eval.yaml.

ABSENCE: no unit-level assertion ties the prose to observable reviewer behavior; emits_valid_findings (eval_scorers.py:404 -> _schema_review_result) only validates output SHAPE, and per the spec header live pass/finding scoring runs offline in eval CI
advisory.finding: The T10 rubric-prose assertions hard-code two full multi-sentence paragraphs verbatim (plus that inter-paragraph whitespace is empty) via _assert_scope_then_safety against an LLM instruction artifact (plan_review_T10.md and its rendered guide/explain output). Because the consumer of this prose is an LLM (not a parser/validator that branches on the exact string), asserting the entire wording verbatim is a change-detector: any behavior-preserving rewording of the scope/safety guidance breaks the tests with no change to observable reviewer behavior. The tests are also blind to whether the reviewer actually treats transient experiments as out-of-scope while still flagging the four MAJOR classes (that behavior is only exercised by the offline live eval).
scenarios: An author rewords the scope/safety guidance for clarity without changing its meaning; the verbatim-prose assertions fail despite no behavior change.
A refactor moves the paragraph or adjusts spacing; the strict-whitespace equality assertion fails.
